encounter.title: Act I Encounter 5 — Square Candidate B (8x8 seed 86)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate B for Act I #5. 8x8 seed 86 (12 arrows: N3 E3 S2 W4). Pattern: CHOICE OF OPENING. Outstanding agency: all 4 directions free on start (N1, E1, S1, W2). Tapping West or South first permits Grunt E to attack on turn 3. Clean sequence: #2(N) -> #1(E) -> #5(E) (kills Grunt E on turn 3) -> #4(N) (kills Thrower N on turn 4). 4 taps clean, 0 damage.
